# Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Complete Guide, Templates & Tools

> Free, open-source collection of SDLC guides, Markdown templates, SVG/PNG diagrams, checklists, examples, and browser tools maintained by Developer Assistants.

- Repository: https://github.com/developer-assistants/awesome-sdlc
- Live site: https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/

## Guides
- [SDLC Guide](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/): Overview, interactive checklist preview, and model comparison.
- [SDLC Meaning](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/meaning/): Plain definition, roles, and SDLC vs STLC vs PDLC.
- [SDLC Phases](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/phases/): All seven phases with artifacts, exit gates, and examples.
- [SDLC Models](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/models/): Waterfall, Agile, V-Model, Spiral, Iterative, plus interactive Model Selector.
- [SDLC Examples](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/examples/): Real-world SaaS, REST API, and regulated firmware walkthroughs.
- [Agile SDLC](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/agile/): SDLC vs Agile comparison, Scrum vs Kanban.
- [Waterfall SDLC](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/waterfall/): Sequential stage gates, strengths, and trade-offs.
- [SDLC Cheat Sheet](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/cheat-sheet/): Printable one-page reference.

## Interactive Tools
- [SDLC Checklist Generator](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/checklist/): Track 7-phase progress and export Markdown.
- [SDLC Diagram Generator](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/diagram/): Generate and download SVG, PNG, and Mermaid diagrams.
- [SDLC Template Builder](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/templates/): Customize and download PRD, SRS, Design Doc, Test Plan, Runbook, and Post-Mortem templates.
- [SDLC Interview Questions & Quiz](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/interview-questions/): 8-question interactive quiz and Q&A bank.
